action.help: exit 0 when vacuous rules are the only shortfall; implies --rule-ids

help.stdout:
usage: gnd check [-h] [--populations POPULATIONS] [--pre PRE] [--steps STEPS]
                 [--post POST] [--compiled-operations] [--anchors ANCHORS]
                 [--document DOCUMENT] [--composition COMPOSITION]
                 [--sources SOURCES] [--admission] [--rule-ids]
                 [--baseline BASE] [--allow-vacuous] [--format {text,json}]
                 model [population]

Two arms, and exactly one runs. SNAPSHOT: a positional population is checked
against the model's constraints. TRANSITION: --pre, --steps and --post audit a
WALK -- the operation invocations claimed to have carried the pre-population
to the post-population -- reporting failed preconditions, undeclared side
effects and illegal intermediate states. Mixing the two, or supplying part of
the transition triple, is a usage error at 64: they answer different
questions, and silently preferring one would make the other's arguments
decorative. Model version 3 supports guarded Date plus/minus Duration
calendar-day terms (date_add/date_sub), selecting report v11; --admission
selects temporal report v13.

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file
  population            path to the population file (YAML or JSON) -- the
                        snapshot arm

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --populations POPULATIONS
                        batch arm: directory of sorted .json/.yaml/.yml
                        population projections
  --pre PRE             transition arm: the population the walk starts from
  --steps STEPS         transition arm: the steps.json document describing the
                        walk
  --post POST           transition arm: the population the walk is claimed to
                        end in
  --compiled-operations
                        check eligible compiled standing subsets; excludes
                        step/frame obligations
  --anchors ANCHORS     bound source anchor sidecar for snapshot checks
  --document DOCUMENT   source document for anchor spans
  --composition COMPOSITION
                        composition record of a composed population; needs
                        --sources
  --sources SOURCES     composition directory the record was composed from
  --admission           include the occurrence admission partition in the
                        check report
  --rule-ids            report version 15: each verdict carries the
                        constraint's declared id and remedy
  --baseline BASE       mark each violation new or standing against the
                        population BASE; implies --rule-ids
  --allow-vacuous       exit 0 when vacuous rules are the only shortfall;
                        implies --rule-ids
  --format {text,json}  output rendering: human-readable text (default) or one
                        JSON payload
